summary: Use Fractal vocabulary and commands throughout active developer and client documentation

replay.detail: Documentation only; no claim or replay changes.

schema.detail: Wire names, protocol examples and generated schemas remain unchanged.

rules.detail: No runtime or authorization rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Installed aliases, environment variables, state paths, telemetry identities and historical records retain their existing spellings.

downtime.detail: No deployment or migration is required.

manual.detail: Active guides use Fractal product prose, retain installed st/st3 command examples, and use the renamed SDK and iOS module paths. The terminal UI guides are now docs/fractal-and-ios.md and docs/fractal-terminal-tab.md; docs/st3 remains in place.

recovery.detail: No runtime state changes; reverting the documentation needs no recovery procedure.
